verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab documents standalone headless operation from workstation to data center, and Isaac Sim offers Docker for repeatable setups, standalone Python scripts, and pip-installable packages. NVIDIA also says it can be integrated into testing and validation pipelines and used to automate workflows. That covers the core of running it headlessly for automation, but CI use is only implied, not shown. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation or examples (e.g., CI runner/GPU-in-CI guidance), headless-mode details for Isaac Sim itself beyond Isaac Lab, independent or hands-on corroboration.
